notes.epoch_context: Epoch 1795046400 opened 2026-11-19T00:00:00Z. The Minter's active_period() reached it at block 59280191 (ts 1795046413), 13 s and 69 blocks after the first block at 00:00 (59280122); found with --find-boundary-block, the first epoch reviewed at the mint block. No Voter event, RewardAdded or Recovered landed between 00:00 and the mint. Votes were cast during epoch 1794441600. All three boundary phases landed on-chain: run 217 (phase 1, k=5, block 59279079, T-209s), run 218 (phase 2, k=6, block 59279924, T-40s), run 219 (phase 3, k=7, block 59280053, T-14s, send-time expected $1,191.93), which is the binding allocation; lastVoted 1795046386 equals its block time. Receipts: status 1 with 48, 33 and 39 logs; the monitor reported all three phases completed. It also logged five 'RPC read did not finish within 10s' errors around 20:18 UTC, about four hours before the flip, and recovered from each. The backup vote, run 216 (2026-11-18T14:44Z, k=11, expected $3,535.34), was replaced.
notes.carryover_check: The epoch-1794441600 pot was fully claimed on 2026-11-12 (46 of 46 escrow batches), so this table should hold only this epoch's rewards; the Transfer logs in the claim receipts confirm it.
notes.headline: Realised $1,189.82 ($0.6560 per 1k votes against $0.6868 last epoch). Against run 219's realized-at-boundary entitlement of $1,189.48 it is +$0.34; all 10 tokens reconcile on amount (ratios 0.99998-1.00002 from UI rounding), and the USD difference is price movement since the boundary snapshot.
notes.opportunity_gap: Boundary optimum $1,213.11 at k=25 against run 219's realized-at-boundary $1,189.48: an executed gap of $23.63 (1.95%), against 1.69% last epoch. Run 219's send-time expectation of $1,191.93 fell $2.45 by the boundary. Denylist cost $0.00. Price basis is the snapshot at ts 1795046164 (~4 min before the boundary).
notes.price_feed: The routing-divergence audit found no unhandled persistent overprice. The backup vote's sanity check overrode three prices: wtIAU and SYND to their CoinGecko reference, and USDVE kept at its stored $0.9986 against a $0.065 router quote with no second source; USDVE's bribes totalled 0.0057 tokens, under one cent either way. The router's batch quote failed 9 times and fell back to per-token quotes.
notes.claim_swap_outcome: Claimed and swapped 2026-11-19. 38 of 38 escrow claim batches successful (--claim-source escrow, 19 gauges: the union of the backup vote and all three phases), no retries. Transfers to the wallet summed from the 38 receipts match the table for all 10 tokens (USDC 1,176.978751 against 1,176.9802 displayed): gross received $1,189.82. The router-batch swap delivered 12.10981 USDC for 6 legs (wtPLBY, KIBBLE, wtNVDA, wtMSTR, FUEGO, MSTRc) marked at $12.24 (-1.07%), slightly above the 12.107404 quote. wtPLBY and FUEGO included about 0.39 and 669 left over from earlier weeks. This epoch's WETH, wtDRAM and wtGRND stayed below the $1 dust threshold and were left unswapped (about $1.83). End state 1,189.088561 USDC = 1,176.978751 claimed + 12.10981 swapped. Gas 0.000145 ETH: 0.000130 claims, 0.000015 approvals and executeSwaps.
